human_feedback:
1. you should almost never take the bites for max health reduction, unless you have the special option, aka having the blood vial relic
2. you took too many cards. try to skip card rewards sometimes when your deck is already solidified. 
3. use armaments+ first almost all the time, regardless of opponent attacking or defending.
4. have a deck combo in mind from the start of the run. like if you are going exhaust combo then pick cards/rewards that contribute to exhaust combos, and skip other cards, or if you are going the status decks, then take cards that makes it better eg flame breathing or wounds and wild strikes
5. if you have no money dont go to the shop unless you are going to die
No additional correction. The initial reflection identifies the important causes and reusable lessons for this run.
